_comment: Light rigs, all relative to the product. S = product bounding-box diagonal. size = light size in S; az/el in degrees (az 0 = product front (-Y side), positive toward +X); dist in S from the product centre; irradiance E in W/m2 at the product, converted to light power P = E * pi * d^2. kelvin = colour temperature. Every light aims at the product centre. world = ambient fill. background/floor = the default studio set for this rig (settings can override). look = AgX look name.

soft_commercial.description: Bright, soft, low-contrast catalogue light: big key softbox front-left, large fill, overhead softbox, gentle rim.

dramatic_premium.description: Dark, high-contrast premium look: narrow strip key from the side, two strong rim strips behind, dark glossy floor.

neutral_technical.description: Even, flat, shadow-light illumination for documentation: two big softboxes, a back light and a bright ambient.

modifiers._comment: settings.lighting keys applied on top of a preset
modifiers.intensity: multiplies every light and the world (1 = preset)
modifiers.softness: multiplies light sizes (bigger = softer shadows and highlights)
modifiers.fill_ratio: multiplies every light except the key (lower = more contrast)
modifiers.warmth_kelvin: added to every light's kelvin (negative = warmer)
modifiers.rotate: degrees added to every light's azimuth (moves the rig around the product)
